headings.styles: Elegant, wide letter-spacing (tracking-wide to tracking-widest) for large display text, all-caps or title case for luxury editorial feel. NEVER use generic sans-serif for headings.

body.styles: Clean, highly legible, modern geometric sans to counterbalance the ornate serif headings. Use leading-relaxed for body copy.

labels_and_nav.styles: Uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs or text-sm for overlines, navigation links, and small CTA text.

background.description: Very dark, near-black with deep burgundy undertones. No pure #000000.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use high-end 'Crystal Glass' effect for sticky navs and floating cards: bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)].
visual_enhancers.textures: Incorporate subtle grain/noise overlays over solid dark backgrounds to create physical depth (like luxury velvet or textured paper).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Deep ambient drop-shadows with slight crimson/gold tint (e.g., shadow-[0_20px_40px_-15px_rgba(107,29,58,0.5)]).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders in gold/10 or white/10 for grid items and bento boxes. NO rounded-3xl or soft bubbly radii; stick to sharp edges (rounded-none) or very subtle radii (rounded-sm/md) for an architectural, premium feel.

layouts.spacing: Exaggerated spacing. Use p-12, p-16, p-24, py-32 to create a museum-like exhibition feel. The products and text need massive breathing room.
layouts.grids: Use the 'Tetris' Bento grid (Mode A) for the Shop/Product showcases and Recipes. Overlapping elements, asymmetrical compositions (e.g., 8-col hero with 4-col overlapping card).
layouts.hero: Full-bleed dark moody imagery or immersive deep-color sections. Large serif typography, generous negative space.
layouts.navigation: Minimalist header. Hide internal pages completely from nav. Show: Shop, Recipes, Blog, About, Contact, Feedback. No clutter.
layouts.alignment: Left-align dense text. Headings can be centered if paired with centered hero layouts, otherwise optical left alignment.

motion.hover_states: Images scale slowly (scale-105 duration-700 ease-out). Text buttons get a subtle gold underline or text color shift. NO frantic or bouncy animations.
motion.scroll_effects: Use Framer Motion or React Spring Parallax for subtle 2.5D parallax on hero images and large product shots. Fade-up (y: 20, opacity: 0) with a long duration (0.8s) for text entrance.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets WCAG AA minimums. Cream (#F7F0E3) on Dark Burgundy (#0A0507) is highly legible. Gold (#C9A96E) must be used carefully against dark backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: Use a subtle gold focus ring (focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#C9A96E] focus:outline-none) for interactive elements.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap heavy animations with prefers-reduced-motion media query respect.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='shop-now-btn').

pages_and_components.Home: Immersive hero section with majestic typography. Featured product trio (Metabo Ignite, Bloom & Flush, Glucose Guard) in an asymmetrical bento grid. Brand story teaser section.
pages_and_components.About: Editorial layout similar to Vogue/Kinfolk. Large high-res imagery paired with deep storytelling about the Manchester origins, artisanal quality, and health science.
pages_and_components.Shop: 3 premium products displayed like museum pieces. Large imagery, rich descriptions. CTAs must clearly link out to Shopify.
pages_and_components.Recipes: Masonry/Asymmetrical grid showcasing 12 research-backed tea recipes. Focus on high-end culinary photography style.
pages_and_components.Blog: Clean, text-focused editorial layout with wide left margins, drop caps, and serif typography.
pages_and_components.Feedback_Event: Minimalist, high-end dark card layout containing the QR code for tea tasting events and a refined feedback form.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-end luxury e-commerce/marketing hybrid app. Treat every pixel as premium real estate.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for main page structures and use Shadcn UI exclusively for complex interactive components (forms, select, dropdowns).
Install and use `lucide-react` for minimalist elegant icons.
Install and use `Cormorant Garamond` and `Manrope` from Google Fonts via standard import in index.css.
Do NOT use pure #000000 or #FFFFFF. Use the defined dark burgundy/crimson tinted blacks and cream whites.
Apply Framer Motion (framer-motion) for slow, cinematic 0.8s entrance animations. Do NOT make animations bouncy or fast.
Implement the bento grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12) for the Shop section to display the 3 teas asymmetrically (e.g., Hero product spans 8 cols, others span 4).
Ensure all interactive components have proper data-testid attributes for testing.
Remove/hide any internal navigation links (PreLaunchChecklist, etc.) from the public router or header.
Do NOT create `.tsx` files if the project uses `.js`/`.jsx`. Check existing file structures first.
Use sonner for any toast notifications (e.g., successful newsletter signup).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
